Lemon delicious pudding

Lemon delicious pudding

A sponge that sits on its own lemon sauce — Nan's favourite.

  • Serves 6
  • Prep 15 mins
  • Cook 45 mins
Marg

Ingredients

  • 60 g butter, softened
  • 1 cup caster sugar
  • 3 eggs, separated
  • 1 ½ cups milk

Method

  1. Preheat oven to 180°C.
  2. Cream the butter and sugar, then beat in the yolks.
  3. Fold in the whites and bake for 45 minutes.
